steps.name: cancel-order-command-handler
steps.summary: Added pure order CancelOrderCommand handler contract with idempotent processed-command handling and OrderCancelledEvent outbox emission.

steps.name: order-status-event-projector
steps.summary: PaymentConfirmedEvent/OrderApprovedEvent를 order PAID/APPROVED 상태로 반영하는 OrderStatusEventProjector와 processed-message 멱등 contract를 추가하고 보상 trigger event는 cancel handler 책임으로 ignored 처리했다.

steps.name: order-lifecycle-adapter-wiring
steps.summary: order.commands CancelOrderCommand listener와 payment/store approval event를 order status projector로 전달하는 Kafka adapter를 추가하고 OrderCancelledEvent topic resolver/export contract를 연결했다.

steps.name: compensation-smoke-gap-closure
steps.summary: happy-path smoke의 수동 order 상태 변경을 projector로 대체하고 compensation smoke가 실제 CancelOrderCommand handler를 호출해 세 보상 sub-scenario 모두 finalOrderStatus=CANCELLED와 cancelOrderHandlerWired=true를 반환하게 했다.

steps.name: order-lifecycle-phase-verification
steps.summary: order lifecycle public contract 테스트와 README/app README 문서화를 추가해 handler/projector/adapter export, wired compensation smoke, 다음 HTTP adapter/live compose/operator observability 후보를 검증했다.
